plan.title: Fitness Programme Impact Summary
plan.subtitle: Comparing baseline and endline physical metrics for enrolled children

panels.title: Total Children
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Child ID") AS n FROM "baseline"

panels.title: Avg Shuttle Run Improvement (sec)
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(b."Shuttle run sec" - e."Shuttle run sec") AS improvement FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Avg Sit-ups Improvement
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups") AS improvement FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Average Shuttle Run Time by Location
panels.sql: SELECT "Location", AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS avg_time FROM "endline" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Average Sit-ups by Gender
panels.sql: SELECT "Gender", AVG("Sit ups") AS avg_situps FROM "endline" GROUP BY 1

plan.narrative:
The fitness programme engaged {{p1}} children across various locations. 

Overall, participants showed an average improvement in shuttle run time of {{p2}} seconds, indicating better speed and agility. 

Strength metrics also improved, with an average increase of {{p3}} sit-ups per child. 

The top performing location in terms of fastest shuttle run times is {{p4}}, while the gender with the highest average sit-up count is {{p5}}.
